variants.name: 01-clean-sans-white
variants.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create one simple typography-only wordmark for a modern Magic: The Gathering card search and deckbuilding website named CARDMYSTIC. Exact sole text: "CARDMYSTIC", spelled C A R D M Y S T I C, uppercase, one horizontal line. PURE WHITE LETTERING ONLY (#FFFFFF), solid uniform near-black #111118 background for presentation. The letters are pure white; no other colors in the lettering. Landscape composition, large centered wordmark, modest margins. Crisp flat vector-like edges and professionally balanced kerning, readable at navigation bar sizes. No icons, wizard hats, stars, cards, symbols, slogans, labels, other text, borders, mockups, textures, shadows, glow, or 3D. The fantasy brand character should be expressed only through subtle typography. Clean geometric sans serif, semibold, slightly wide proportions and subtle tracking. Precise circular C, clear A crossbar, confident symmetrical M. Simple contemporary software brand lettering. All letter strokes must be perfectly solid and smooth. Absolutely no distressed texture, speckling, roughness, noise, outlines, grit, overlapping letters or splatter. Leave clear visible spacing between every letter. Render like pristine typesetting from a real font.
